summary.en: Ran, Sonoko, and Conan are in the shopping mall, where they meet model girls promoting a new toy seal. Later, they heard a scream, and found one of the models is dead. Accident? or Murder? Location: Beika shopping mall storage room Time: Around 2:30 PM Cause of death: Falling Suspects: Mina Komoro, Mai Fukamoto, and Yuko Oyodo After hearing a loud scream, Sonoko, Conan and Ran head to the storage room only to find Mai Fukamoto pointing towards Ayaka's corpse. After early investigations by the police, a letter addressed to Mai and was found. They also found Mai's brooch near the crime scene. All suspicion goes towards Mai, even though she denies it. Conan then investigate and found out the real culprit.
